Subject: PO timing question — discount eligibility if PO acceptance slips

Hi Kimberly,

We are finalizing the PO for the upcoming Redwood Dedicated deployment (HSX-4821) and have a quick operational question from our AP team. Our legal sign-off is complete but our ERP won't push the PO into your system until next week (anticipated 9/21) because of an internal approval queue.

Two asks:
- Will a delayed PO acceptance (Redwood-side acceptance expected the same day we send it) affect the eligibility for the 12% volume discount that was quoted in the SOW?
- Does Redwood require any specific PO field values (entity, BU code, service line) to be present at time of acceptance for the discount to apply, or can those be remediated later via credit?

I've attached our PO template and a sample export from our ERP. Please advise — procurement needs this documented for our AP team.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: PO timing question — discount eligibility if PO acceptance slips

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and attachments. Quick answers up front, then details below:

- Short answer: a delayed submission from your side does not automatically void the quoted 12% volume discount, provided the PO references deal HSX-4821 and is received within 30 days of the SOW effective date.
- Required fields at acceptance: we need the PO to include (1) legal entity name, (2) PO number, and (3) billing BU code (or an explicit mapping to your ERP entity). If any of those are missing at intake we can accept provisionally but will need a remediation ticket within 45 days to apply the discount.

Details / operational options:
1) Acceptance window: Our intake process marks the PO accepted when our billing system ingests a valid PO file that includes a PO number. If Hospix pushes the PO on 9/21 and it's ingested the same day, the acceptance timestamp will be 9/21 and the discount remains intact (given the 30-day window above).
2) Provisional acceptance path: If your PO is missing BU code but has the PO number and entity, we can accept and create an internal remediation (PR-XXXX) to reconcile the BU code. The discount will be held pending reconciliation; once the BU code is patched within 45 days we will apply a credit to the next invoice.
3) Early-pay / invoice cadence: If Hospix opts for a monthly consolidated invoice (preferred for you), please flag that on the PO (InvoiceCadence=Monthly). Early-pay incentives (2% for payment within 15 days) can be honored only if PO explicitly references the early-pay term in the acceptance payload.

I'll loop in our procurement ops for any technical PO field mapping. Attaching the intake checklist for your AP team.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Finance Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Vanessa / Kim — confirmed from finance ops:
- Credit approach: We prefer issuing a negative line item on the next consolidated invoice when the adjustment is under $25k. For credits larger than that we generate a credit memo to preserve the audit trail.
- Lead time: Once remediation ticket is closed and BU mapping validated, allow one invoice cycle (up to 30 days) for the credit to appear. If Hospix needs a faster turnaround we can push an off-cycle credit memo but require AP-level approval (procure@hospix.com) and a brief support ticket.

I'll add this language to the acceptance note back to Hospix.

Ben
Head of Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
